newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open firmer on stock option approvals.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open firmer on stock option approvals.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened higher on Tuesday, as companies that received approval to list stock options on the Tokyo and Osaka exchanges later this year attracted buying, brokers said.
But shares in Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) fell on Japanese media reports that Tokyo prosecutors entered the bank's headquarters in an apparent raid.
At 0014 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average rose 86.21 points or 0.42 percent to 20,575.96. June Nikkei futures rose 40 points to 20,590.
